did.description: The target account's DID whose access list is being modified.

clear.description: Where true, empty the access list before applying `add`. Applied first; combining `clear: true` with `add` replaces the list wholesale.

add.description: The DIDs to add to the account's access list. Applied after `clear`. Entries already present are ignored.

remove.description: The DIDs to remove from the account's access list. Applied last. Entries not present are ignored.

Response.title: Messaging Update Access List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a messaging/access-list/update request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/access-list/update/0.1#response.

did.description: The account whose access list was modified.

added.description: The entries actually added (those not already present when `add` was applied).

removed.description: The entries actually removed by `remove` (those present when it was applied). Entries dropped by `clear` are not enumerated here.

accessListCount.description: The resulting number of entries in the account's access list.
